name: kicad
description: Design, inspect, validate, and export KiCad schematics and PCBs from natural-language prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Create and review KiCad circuit boards from prompts.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a local KiCad installation and adds an engineering workflow for requirements, schematic capture, PCB layout, ERC/DRC, and manufacturing outputs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Design a KiCad circuit board from my requirements, verify it with ERC and DRC, and clearly report assumptions and remaining engineering risks.
